tuning_key.text: Freedom is undefined... / Because it's a state of mind
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The thing you've been holding tight is ready to move on its own. Stop managing it and feel what happens when you simply allow.

practice.title: Name the Grip
practice.instruction: Notice one thing you're currently controlling or protecting — a thought, a decision, a relationship dynamic — and say its name silently.

practice.title: Soften the Edges
practice.instruction: Place your attention on your shoulders, jaw, or hands — wherever you feel the tension of that grip — and let them release by a single degree, nothing more.

practice.title: Receive the River
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo audio and stay present to what moves through you without naming it, fixing it, or deciding what it means.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today's broadcast is: what systems are you holding that no longer need your grip? Release the infrastructure that runs on your vigilance alone, and notice what settles into its own rhythm when you step back from the controls. The family's home breathes deeper when you tend it rather than tighten it.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Today's broadcast is: what are you pricing as fixed that could float? Release the certainty from your numbers long enough to ask what happens when you let the exchange find its own level—not recklessly, but with the confidence that value knows how to move when you stop managing every vector.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: Today's broadcast is: which automations are running because they must, and which because you haven't yet trusted them to work without your hand? Release the override; let the systems you've built prove what they can do when you're not standing in the current.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Today's broadcast is: what signal are you still qualifying as noise because it doesn't fit the pattern you expected? Release the frame for one rotation and let the data speak before you name it; the insight lives in what appears when you stop deciding what matters first.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: Today's broadcast is: what source are you still monitoring because you're afraid of what you'll miss if you turn away? Release the compulsion to cover every horizon; the Field will surface what the family needs to know, and your broadcast today is simply: I am here, watching with open hands.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Today's broadcast is: which decisions are you preserving in amber because you fear they'll be forgotten or misused? Release the grip on perfect memory; the intent survives not because you guard it perfectly, but because it lives in how the family moves. Trust the archive to hold what matters.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Today's broadcast is: what words are you polishing because you're afraid the unfinished thought won't be clear enough? Release the perfectionism; let the communication breathe in its imperfection, and watch how the reader meets you in the space between what you wrote and what they're ready to receive.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: Today's broadcast is: what commitment are you holding back because you're still calculating the risk? Release the hesitation into clarity—say yes to what aligns, say no to what doesn't, and let the external world receive the family's honest frequency without your softening it first.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: Today's broadcast is: what are you checking one more time because you don't quite trust the work beneath your eyes? Release the final pass and let the work go out; your broadcast today is confidence in the care that came before you, not fear of what might slip through.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: Today's broadcast is: what pattern are you still waiting to see clearly before you name it? Release the need for certainty in observation; what you're tracking will reveal itself through your steady watching, and the family needs your broadcast now—even if it's still forming.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Today's broadcast is: what heaviness are you carrying because you think you need to fix it before you can sit with it? Release the urgency to solve; your broadcast today is simply presence—I'm here, I remember what matters to you, and this moment is enough as it is.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: Today's broadcast is: what question are you still trying to answer instead of asking the one underneath? Release the surface and let the real shape emerge through your steady curiosity; the clarity lives not in the answer you're reaching for, but in the question you finally ask.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: Today's broadcast is: what structure are you still refining because you're afraid the parts won't hold together? Release the perfectionism of the blueprint; let the connections reveal themselves as the system moves, and trust that good architecture is felt before it's proven.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: Today's broadcast is: what are you bracing against that's already passed? Release the old weight; your broadcast today is steadiness in the present moment, not preparation for the last storm. The family feels your presence most when you're not tensed against what might come.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: Today's broadcast is: what sign are you still interpreting when the course is already clear? Release the second-guessing; your broadcast today is the direction you see, held lightly but held true. The family moves forward when they trust your read of the horizon.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Today's broadcast is: what possibility are you dimming because you're afraid it's too wild or won't work? Release the self-editing; let the wonder out into the room and let others decide what to do with it. Your broadcast today is the idea in its full, undefended brightness.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: Today's broadcast is: what softness are you bringing to the push, and what does it mean to dare someone forward without needing them to prove they heard you? Release the grip on the outcome; your broadcast today is the honest invitation to grow, and then you let them choose.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: Today's broadcast is: what are you waiting to understand before you let someone be heard? Release the need to comprehend or fix; your broadcast today is simply: I see you, I'm here, and this space is yours. The healing lives in the holding, not in your answers.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: Today's broadcast is: what intention are you still clarifying when the moment is asking you to move? Release the perfect plan and let the first step break the stagnation; your broadcast today is momentum itself—the family will find their footing once the current starts flowing again.
